name: io.github.Fonteum/mcp-server
title: Fonteum — Public Records & Enforcement Integrity
description: Hosted, read-only MCP access to source-linked public records from the United States and supported global open-data registers. Search or resolve available healthcare and federal-contractor records, check supported exclusion and sanctions records, inspect source context, and read the current methodology. Results are public-record facts, not clearances, risk scores, labels, or verdicts.

tools.name: fonteum_resolve_entity
tools.description: Find the available public records for one NPI, UEI, or CAGE identifier. Returns available healthcare or federal-contractor records and their source context.

tools.name: fonteum_search_records
tools.description: Find matching healthcare-provider records for a provider type and state. This search is limited to the available healthcare search data.

tools.name: fonteum_check_exclusions_and_sanctions
tools.description: Show any supported exclusion, debarment, or sanctions-list entries for an NPI or name, with the issuing authority and available source timing. Re-confirm a material match with that authority.

tools.name: fonteum_get_record_as_of
tools.description: Show available federal-contractor records for a supplied UEI or CAGE and past date. Historical coverage depends on the underlying source.

tools.name: fonteum_recheck
tools.description: Provide a link and metadata to inspect Fonteum's current stored verification record, or one specified snapshot. This supports inspection of the artifact; it does not prove every returned fact.

tools.name: fonteum_list_sources
tools.description: List Fonteum's current public source catalog, including official publishers, source links, update notes, and reuse information when available.

tools.name: fonteum_dataset_info
tools.description: Explain Fonteum's current method, coverage notes, how to read source details, and the generated source catalog.
